doc: Callback ledger of the three new eras (spec/H section 3.6). Machine-checked by tools/callbacks_lint.mjs (reference implementation: spec/H appendix B). Source of truth for: src/content/shared/callbacks_gen.js (generated, committed, no-diff gate), the announcer cond.cb flags, the briefing/card/progression renderers, and tests/humor/callbacks.test.mjs.

format.entry: {id, aliases?, type, sourceEra, targetEra, requiresReleased[], source{key,surface,voice,text,frozen,class}, target{key,surface,voice,text,where}, gate, repeat, origin, check}
format.type: setup-free = the TARGET is funny cold (no gate; must pass the cold-read comprehension check); gated = the TARGET renders only while its gate is open and at most once per profile (seen.callbacks["<id>:t"])
format.keys: <surface>:<id>[:<n>]; surfaces: ann (announcer template id), prog (results-card progression footer of the first win of a mission), brief (briefing line n or :tag), sp (set-piece line n), card (arrival/cleared card: card:<era>:<arrival|arrival.footer.<k>|cleared>), chooser, codex (codex:<unit>:<field>), power (god-power tooltip or cast line), load (loading screen), label (voice label), poster, defeat, progress (a save fact, no line). Ancient keys are real template ids of src/content/era_ancient/humor/announcer.js (frozen, source.frozen=true, source.text read from the live template).
format.gate: null (setup-free) | {kind:"cb", flag, setBy} | {kind:"derived", expr, seq?} | {kind:"any"|"all", parts:[gate...]}

derivedVocabulary.mission_star:<missionId>: progress.stars[missionId] >= 1 (written by meta.recordMission; no new writer)
derivedVocabulary.era_cleared:<eraId>: progress.eras[eraId].cleared === true (AR 3.5.2; Ancient derived on migration from the nine mission stars)
derivedVocabulary.stat:<path>>=<n>: lifetime stats path in the whitelist: chickenKills, trojanReveals, battles, wins, godPowers.<powerId>, byDef.<defId>.spawned, eraStats.<era>.<key> (statOf helper of CU 3.9.3)

format.cb: flag = seen.callbacks[flag] === true. Writer: callbacks.mark(flag) in src/ui/hud/_progress.js (CU 3.19.5), called from the single place named in setBy: the announcer adapter in meta.js when the emitted line key equals setBy (new-era templates carry cbSet; Ancient and reused ids go through the cbSources map below), the briefing/teaching/set-piece/card/loading renderer for their keys, or voiceLabel for label:*. The flag is set when the line is RENDERED, not when it is selected.
format.seq: true on a derived gate whose source mission precedes the target mission in the same era: always satisfied in normal play because missions unlock in order; the lint proves the order

storage.rendered: seen.callbacks["<id>:t"] (boolean; gated targets render once per profile)
storage.capacity: 57 rendered marks + 12 flags = well under the 400-key cap

cbSources.doc: Ancient lines are frozen (G4) and carry no cbSet: the announcer adapter marks these flags when the named template id is RENDERED. eraScope limits where the mark is taken.
